dependencies.condition: For implementation methods, including TDD at agreed test seams and source-backed or design-first work when applicable.
For the complete change’s final review unless the user explicitly skips it; reuse adequate same-checkpoint evidence.
When All Tickets mode coordinates fresh ticket implementers, exploration or merger subagents.

sources.adaptation: Keep upstream implement-spec prose nearly verbatim as Implement’s All Tickets mode, selected by dependency-linked tickets rather than a spec document. Support local tickets without Matt setup; use Team Up for assignments and Engineering Principles in place of tdd. Surgical changes only: base resets apply only to worktrees without their own work; mergers validate the merged result and only validated merges advance the frontier; implementers return missing test seams and consequential trade-offs to the coordinator; Implement’s shared delivery replaces the code-review step, after which the PR is marked ready and tickets are resolved per their closure mechanism.

rulings.decision: All Tickets owns dependency scheduling, fresh workers and merger-validated integration; Implement owns the shared final review, PR and CI cycle. Engineering Principles supplies implementation methods. Local tickets need no external tracker setup. Base resets apply only to worktrees without their own work. The coordinator owns user decisions, including missing test seams.
